name: job-search-os
description: The AI operating system for a job search in any profession: a command center and five end-to-end jobs — tailor and apply, work my inbox, prep for an interview, follow up and negotiate, run my weekly review — drafting into Gmail, Calendar, and Drive with your approval, with living trackers. Hourly, salaried, commission, or salary-schedule pay, each checked against your minimum pay like with like; every claim traces to your own record.
